findings.location: scripts/verify-rebuild.sh vrb_check_10 (decision probe requires decision_list); dd-acceptance record in commit e46a4b0
findings.summary: Hard acceptance criterion unmet: spec §二 requires checks 01/02/10 to PASS in --env test mode and the fenced dd-acceptance asserts pass010=3; the recorded run on the final tree exited 1 with lines=21, pass010=2 — check 10 FAIL because the decision MCP face exposes no decision_list read-only tool (src/fleet_graph/decision_mcp.py registers only decision_deliver, line 1141, verified by inspection). The gap is mechanically unfixable inside R1's boundary (01–21 judgment logic byte-frozen, exactly-three-files delivery limit, only systemctl and LLM-ledger stubs permitted), so it needs dispatcher action: amend the R1 positive criterion (e.g. 01/02 green + 10 honest red-with-basis, pass010=2) or schedule an engine-side decision read tool as a precondition and re-run acceptance.

Down-side baseline diff re-fetches and diffs only prod-baseline/lines.json; the runs-tree.txt snapshot taken at up is never re-fetched or diffed at down, while §一·4 基线留痕 requires both artifacts re-fetched and diffed into down output. Informational element only; the two hard causal assertions (prod_write_fds=0, prod_references=0) are unaffected.

Zero-test-deletion assertion compares the worktree file blob to the HEAD blob, which is self-referential once the R1 change is committed — it cannot detect a committed modification or deletion of tests/test_r0_verify_rebuild.py. §三.8 intends the R0 test file hash unchanged vs the pre-R1 baseline; comparing against the base-commit blob would give the intended guarantee.

te_spawn_faces additionally reads /data/fleet-graph/dd/plugin-binding.json (read-only, copied into TEST_ROOT/config) — a third read surface on /data/fleet-graph beyond the two enumerated in §四 (baseline snapshot, prod_references grep). Read-only and TEST_ROOT-bounded, but it should be named in the boundary or derived inside TEST_ROOT.
